memories.content: A student in the play who expects flowers from the parents' group. They know the performance starts at 19:00 on Friday and that the parents' group usually organizes flowers.

Petersfield Secondary's play opening night is Friday at 19:00. The parents' group typically collects money from parents to buy flowers for the cast and hands them over backstage before the curtain rises. The handover must occur before 19:00 on Friday.
